summary: Tested the Stage 2 graph, the shorter invitation email, the removals/renames and a regression run on the public URL at 1920 and 390. Backend: new file test_iter16_graph_email.py has 7 tests, all passing. It covers graph bands and edges for a project built from the Audit Retail brief (read, then all readings applied), with source->change->site edges; cross-firm X-Project-Id returns 404 with no payload; anonymous returns 401; the canonical draft links 12 sites to firms, with no 'not in plan' firm among owners; moving one site in a private draft adds exactly one 'private draft' node with edges to its site and firm, and discarding removes it; the email preview subject and one-sentence text are exact, with sendable=false for .test addresses; assistant meta has model and elapsed_ms, with no topics. Regression: test_stage123_security.py passes 15/15. Frontend: the header firm name is vertically centered with a divider (0px center offset). The read form has no sample buttons, its Kind/Label/Date inputs are aligned (same y and height) and the label reads 'Date'. 'Gaps' title, 'No candidate yet.', 'Payment and prerequisites' and the 'Firms' card with 'Check draft' in its header all appear as described. Firm toggles are buttons (no checkboxes), aria-pressed flips on click, and the selection changes the candidate (A/B/C gives alder/birch/cedar; adding Redwood gives alder/birch/redwood). The own-crew button is disabled at capacity 0. Clicking graph-node-firm-alder lights S02, S03 and the firm, dims the other 14 nodes and highlights 2 paths; a second click clears it. Clicking the source node lights the full chain, and clicking a private-draft node lights mv->site->firm. The Decide 'Next' block, the 'Each partner's status' lead, 'One workable arrangement' and 'Availability needs confirmation' are all gone. The email dialog shows To, Subject, body and the synthetic-address notice. The flow draft -> Request review -> demo Alder confirms -> reload works: Alder shows 'Confirmed proposed terms' in the graph and '1 of 3 answered'. The assistant replied with mode 'ANSWER · NO CHANGES' and meta 'claude-sonnet-5-5 · 8.3s'. At 390: no horizontal overflow (scrollWidth 390), bands stack in one column and the SVG lines are hidden.

minor.issue: If a site entry leaves out deadline_week, that site's deadline is silently cleared to None (by_id[...]['deadline_week'] = L.whole(None...)). A client that sends only owner/week wipes every deadline, and the diff/graph then marks all 12 sites as changed. The UI sends deadline_week, so this is an API footgun rather than a user-visible bug. Suggest keeping the existing deadline when the field is omitted.

The frontend refetches the graph only when project.rev changes. A partner response may not bump rev, so firm status nodes can show old data until the page reloads (seen updated after reload; live update not verified).

ui_bugs.issue: The header still reads 'Partner · plan v{N}'. The request asked to remove '· plan vN' from labels. Other version labels also remain: the rail shows 'v2' / 'v3 draft', and the facts card says 'Proposed changes v3 are open'.

issues: When the Sites band has more than 6 nodes it uses a 2-column grid, which truncates site names ('Oakridge b…', 'Harbor Poi…'). Change labels are also truncated ('Job: ceiling, customer name,…'), and there is no title tooltip to see the full text.
In the canonical demo the Sources and Changes columns are empty ('None'), which leaves half the card blank.
Lines from left-column site nodes pass under right-column site nodes, so crossings are hard to follow.

The graph is about 744px tall and sits above the task content on every step, so on mobile users scroll past a full screen of graph before reaching Check/Draft/Invite/Decide. Consider collapsing it by default on small screens or showing it only on one step.
Date fields use the native browser picker (input type=date) instead of the shadcn calendar.
This button returns to /projects, not to the project the user came from.

action_items: Remove '· plan v{N}' from the DecideTask table header, and decide whether the rail and facts-card version labels should also go.
TraceGraph: add a title attribute to nodes for the full label; consider a single column or wider nodes for Sites; collapse the graph by default on mobile.
PUT /api/project/preview: keep the existing deadline_week when it is omitted.
Optionally refetch the graph when partner statuses change, not only when rev changes.
critical_code_review_comments: graph_routes.py is authorized correctly through get_project (404 cross-firm, 401 anonymous) and excludes _id. Edges are filtered to known node ids.
graph_routes.short(): the first-match startswith/endswith order over FIELD could mislabel fields that share a prefix or suffix; an explicit field->label map would be safer.
TraceGraph: refs.current never drops removed nodes. Detached nodes have zero width and are filtered out, so this is harmless, but the refs map grows.

DraftTask: includeOwn defaults to true and include_own:true is sent even when own capacity is 0. The backend handles it (the candidate generated fine), but sending includeOwn && ownCap>0 would be clearer.

success_rate.frontend: 95% (all requested items verified; 1 leftover 'plan vN' label)

seed_data_creation: Registered TEST organizers test_{G,H,UI}_<rand>@example.com (pilot_active set in Mongo, password password123) with projects 'TEST Audit Retail' / 'TEST Audit Retail UI'. Demo sandboxes used visitor ids t16-*/t16ui-*. No real email sent (email-send was not called).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run the backend tests with -n 0. The frontend visitor-id localStorage key is 'assemble_visitor', not 'assemble_visitor_id'; it must match the visitor_id used at login, or 'Review as this partner (demo)' logs into a different sandbox and shows 'issued to a different firm contact'. Log in through page.request.post('/api/auth/login', headers Origin=BASE). Graph node testids: graph-node-{id with non-alphanumerics replaced by '-'}, e.g. graph-node-firm-alder, graph-node-mv-S12, graph-node-src-src-xxxx. Rail steps: rail-step-{intake,draft,ask,decide}; on mobile use task-step-*.
rca of the issue: The 'all 12 sites changed' artifact seen in the first test run came from the test omitting deadline_week in PUT /preview. edit_preview overwrites deadline_week with None for each submitted site, so the diff marked every site as changed.
